record_title: Sharp stagewise-safe Richardson frontier and a no-acceleration barrier
limitations: Exact arithmetic and SPD matrices only; the robust criterion is uniform over a continuous spectral interval and imposes Euclidean nonexpansiveness on every first-order Richardson factor. It does not cover floating-point stability, stable three-term Chebyshev recurrences, parameter orderings that allow temporary amplification, or discrete-spectrum tailoring. Full theorem-level text of the 1961 Golub-Varga papers was not inspected, leaving residual originality risk.
